descriptions.en: Restores 10 HP to its user.
descriptions.zhHans: 使自身恢复10点HP。

descriptions.en: Restores 20 HP to its user.
descriptions.zhHans: 使自身恢复20点HP。

descriptions.en: Restores 40 HP to its user.
descriptions.zhHans: 使自身恢复40点HP。

descriptions.en: +5 maximum HP for the duration of one mission when used.
descriptions.zhHans: 使用后，本章期间最大HP+5。

descriptions.en: +2 strength for the duration of one mission when used.
descriptions.zhHans: 使用后，本章期间力量+2。

descriptions.en: +2 magic for the duration of one mission when used.
descriptions.zhHans: 使用后，本章期间魔法+2。

descriptions.en: +2 skill for the duration of one mission when used.
descriptions.zhHans: 使用后，本章期间技巧+2。

descriptions.en: +2 speed for the duration of one mission when used.
descriptions.zhHans: 使用后，本章期间速度+2。

descriptions.en: +2 luck for the duration of one mission when used.
descriptions.zhHans: 使用后，本章期间幸运+2。

descriptions.en: +2 defense for the duration of one mission when used.
descriptions.zhHans: 使用后，本章期间防御+2。

descriptions.en: +2 resistance for the duration of one mission when used.
descriptions.zhHans: 使用后，本章期间魔防+2。

descriptions.en: Recovers 10 HP to all adjacent allies.
descriptions.zhHans: 使相邻的所有友军恢复10点HP。

descriptions.en: Restores 25 HP to its user.
descriptions.zhHans: 使自身恢复25点HP。

descriptions.en: Restores 10 HP to the user, and also grants +2 strength, +2 skill, and +2 speed for the duration of the mission.
descriptions.zhHans: 使自身恢复10点HP；本章期间力量、技巧、速度各+2。

descriptions.en: +2 strength, +2 magic, +2 skill, +2 speed, +4 luck, +2 defense, +2 resistance for the duration of one mission when used.
descriptions.zhHans: 使用后，本章期间力量、魔法、技巧、速度、防御、魔防各+2，幸运+4。

descriptions.en: Can only be used when paired up and both units of the pair are capable of supporting.Slightly boosts support between the user and their partner.
descriptions.zhHans: 仅可在双人组队时使用，且两名单位可相互支援。略微提升使用者与搭档的支援度。

descriptions.en: Trigger Rally Speed for all allies within a two-square radius of the user by 4 each for the rest of the turn.
descriptions.zhHans: 使自身周围2格内的所有友军在本回合获得「速度应援」效果，速度+4。

descriptions.en: Trigger Rally Defense skill for all allies within a two-square radius of the user by 4 each for the rest of the turn.
descriptions.zhHans: 使自身周围2格内的所有友军在本回合获得「防御应援」效果，防御+4。

descriptions.en: Used to open a single door.Vanishes after the end of the map if unused.
descriptions.zhHans: 用于打开一扇门。若未使用，章节结束后消失。

descriptions.en: Used to open a single chest.Vanishes after the end of the map if unused.
descriptions.zhHans: 用于打开一个宝箱。若未使用，章节结束后消失。

descriptions.en: Opens any door or treasure chest.
descriptions.zhHans: 可打开任意门或宝箱。

descriptions.en: Permanently increases maximum HP by 5 points when used.
descriptions.zhHans: 使用后，最大HP永久+5。

descriptions.en: Permanently increases strength by 2 points when used.
descriptions.zhHans: 使用后，力量永久+2。

descriptions.en: Permanently increases magic by 2 points when used.
descriptions.zhHans: 使用后，魔法永久+2。

descriptions.en: Permanently increases skill by 2 points when used.
descriptions.zhHans: 使用后，技巧永久+2。

descriptions.en: Permanently increases speed by 2 points when used.
descriptions.zhHans: 使用后，速度永久+2。

descriptions.en: Permanently increases luck by 4 points when used.
descriptions.zhHans: 使用后，幸运永久+4。

descriptions.en: Permanently increases defense by 2 points when used.
descriptions.zhHans: 使用后，防御永久+2。

descriptions.en: Permanently increases resistance by 2 points when used.
descriptions.zhHans: 使用后，魔防永久+2。

descriptions.en: Permanently increases all stats by 1 point each when used.
descriptions.zhHans: 使用后，所有能力永久各+1。

descriptions.en: Permanently increases movement by 1 point when used.Cannot be used on the same character more than twice.
descriptions.zhHans: 使用后，移动力永久+1。同一单位最多可使用2次。

descriptions.en: Raises the user's weapon levels in all weapon types available to their current class by one tier each.
descriptions.zhHans: 使当前职业可使用的所有武器类型的武器等级各提升1级。

descriptions.en: Initiates class change for every base class when at Level 10 or higher.
descriptions.zhHans: 基础职业达到10级或以上时使用，可转职为上级职业。

descriptions.en: Initiates reclassing for the unit using it.
descriptions.zhHans: 使使用者转职为可选的其他职业。

descriptions.en: Allows the unit to reclass into a class tree based on their spouse's base class tree.
descriptions.zhHans: 使使用者转职为与配偶初始职业对应的职业树。

descriptions.en: Allows the unit to reclass into a class tree based on their buddy's base class tree.
descriptions.zhHans: 使使用者转职为与挚友初始职业对应的职业树。

descriptions.en: Reclasses the unit into a advanced class and adjust its stats to match.Usable only by children characters.
descriptions.zhHans: 仅限子代单位使用。使使用者转职为上级职业，并调整其能力值。

descriptions.en: When used at an advanced class unit's maximum level, increases the user's maximum level by 5.
descriptions.zhHans: 上级职业达到等级上限时使用，使等级上限+5。

descriptions.en: Initiates reclass for the user (if level 10 base or in an advanced class), promoting them to Dread Fighter.
descriptions.zhHans: 基础职业达到10级或以上，或为上级职业时使用，使使用者转职为魔战士。

descriptions.en: Initiates reclass for the user (if level 10 base or in an advanced class), promoting them to Dark Falcon.
descriptions.zhHans: 基础职业达到10级或以上，或为上级职业时使用，使使用者转职为黑天马。

descriptions.en: Initiates reclass for the user (if level 10 base or in an advanced class), promoting them to Ballistician. Male units only.
descriptions.zhHans: 仅限男性单位。基础职业达到10级或以上，或为上级职业时使用，使使用者转职为炮台。

descriptions.en: Initiates reclass for the user (if level 10 base or in an advanced class), promoting them to Witch. Female units only.
descriptions.zhHans: 仅限女性单位。基础职业达到10级或以上，或为上级职业时使用，使使用者转职为魔女。

descriptions.en: Initiates reclass for the user (if level 10 base or in an advanced class), promoting them to Lodestar. Male units only.
descriptions.zhHans: 仅限男性单位。基础职业达到10级或以上，或为上级职业时使用，使使用者转职为星之领主。

descriptions.en: Initiates reclass for the user (if level 10 base or in an advanced class), promoting them to Great Lord. Female units only.
descriptions.zhHans: 仅限女性单位。基础职业达到10级或以上，或为上级职业时使用，使使用者转职为大领主。

descriptions.en: Initiates reclass for the user (if level 10 base or in an advanced class), promoting them to Grandmaster. Male units only.
descriptions.zhHans: 仅限男性单位。基础职业达到10级或以上，或为上级职业时使用，使使用者转职为大军师。

descriptions.en: Initiates reclass for the user (if level 10 base or in an advanced class), promoting them to Vanguard. Male units only.
descriptions.zhHans: 仅限男性单位。基础职业达到10级或以上，或为上级职业时使用，使使用者转职为神将。

descriptions.en: Teaches the skill Paragon to a single unit.
descriptions.zhHans: 使一名单位习得「精英」。

descriptions.en: Teaches the skill Point Blank to a single unit.
descriptions.zhHans: 使一名单位习得「近接射击」。

descriptions.en: Teaches the skill Strengthtaker to a single unit.
descriptions.zhHans: 使一名单位习得「力量吸收」。

descriptions.en: Teaches the skill Magictaker to a single unit.
descriptions.zhHans: 使一名单位习得「魔力吸收」。

descriptions.en: Teaches the skill Skilltaker to a single unit.
descriptions.zhHans: 使一名单位习得「技巧吸收」。

descriptions.en: Teaches the skill Speedtaker to a single unit.
descriptions.zhHans: 使一名单位习得「速度吸收」。

descriptions.en: Teaches the skill Lucktaker to a single unit.
descriptions.zhHans: 使一名单位习得「幸运吸收」。

descriptions.en: Teaches the skill Defensetaker to a single unit.
descriptions.zhHans: 使一名单位习得「防御吸收」。

descriptions.en: Teaches the skill Resistancetaker to a single unit.
descriptions.zhHans: 使一名单位习得「魔防吸收」。

descriptions.en: Teaches the skill Heavy Blade to a single unit.
descriptions.zhHans: 使一名单位习得「刚剑」。

descriptions.en: Teaches the skill Veteran Intuition to a single unit.If used by a base or special class, character must be level 10 minimum.Advanced classes may use at any level.
descriptions.zhHans: 使一名单位习得「历战之勘」。基础职业或特殊职业须达到10级才能使用；上级职业不限等级。

descriptions.en: Teaches the skill Aether to a single unit.Cannot be used by base classes.If used by a special class, character must be level 25 minimum; if used by an advanced class, character must be level 5 minimum.
descriptions.zhHans: 使一名单位习得「天空」。基础职业无法使用；特殊职业须达到25级、上级职业须达到5级才能使用。

descriptions.en: Teaches the skill Warp to a single unit.Cannot be used by base classes.If used by a special class, character must be level 35 minimum; if used by an advanced class, character must be level 15 minimum.
descriptions.zhHans: 使一名单位习得「传送」。基础职业无法使用；特殊职业须达到35级、上级职业须达到15级才能使用。

descriptions.en: Can be spent to trigger the Spendthrift skill.
descriptions.zhHans: 可消耗以发动「挥霍」特技。

descriptions.en: +2 strength, magic, skill, and speed when in inventory.
descriptions.zhHans: 持有时，力量、魔法、技巧、速度各+2。

descriptions.en: +2 luck, defense, and resistance when in inventory.
descriptions.zhHans: 持有时，幸运、防御、魔防各+2。

descriptions.en: +1 strength, magic, skill, speed, luck, defense and resistance when in inventory.
descriptions.zhHans: 持有时，力量、魔法、技巧、速度、幸运、防御、魔防各+1。

descriptions.en: Allows the user to position the obstacle onto an adjacent tile.Once placed, the space the "Obstacle" is set onto can no longer be traversed.They may be picked back up by player units after being placed.Vanishes after chapter's end if unused.
descriptions.zhHans: 可将障碍物放置在相邻的地格。放置后，该格无法通行。可由玩家单位回收；若未使用，章节结束后消失。
